$comment: Recorded mutations for the #391 work (branch claude/wizardly-cerf-eqzmwa, verified at 49bc489).
They belong in tests/mutation-manifest.json, which agent sessions may not edit: append these to its `mutations` array and delete this file.
Each `find` was checked unique in its source at 49bc489 and each mutant was run and went red.
Entry 6 carries the expect_detail corrected by the final review (the runner's first-diff window no longer reaches the old line).
Not included: the two hook-side rethrow-filter entries and the regate of the case-70 cycle entry — both depend on test changes tracked in the follow-up issues.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when assertSize splices a bare type name
mutations.why: node prints `must be of type number` for Buffer.alloc('5'); a bare 'number' prints `must be number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when checkBounds splices a bare type name
mutations.why: every fixed-width read/write reports its offset type error here; node says `must be of type number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when Buffer.concat's length check splices a bare type name
mutations.why: Buffer.concat(list, '5') must say `The "length" argument must be of type number`.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the deprecated Buffer(n) skips assertSize
mutations.why: Buffer(-1) would throw JSC's codeless 'length cannot be negative' and Buffer(NaN) return an empty Buffer; node throws ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the more-bytes separator is dropped with no hex shown
mutations.why: node prints `<Buffer  ... 3 more bytes>` (two spaces) when INSPECT_MAX_BYTES = 0.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the Buffer inspect hook stops rendering extra own properties
mutations.why: node shows a Buffer's extra own properties after the bytes.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the symbol-key loop stops filtering non-enumerables
mutations.why: node lists a non-enumerable symbol-keyed extra only under showHidden.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when isPlainKey accepts a leading digit
mutations.why: node's keyStrRegExp quotes '1a'.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when a context-only buf.inspect(0, {}) stops rendering extras
mutations.why: node renders extras for a direct call with an options object and no inspect function.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when the Buffer overflow catch swallows non-overflow errors
mutations.why: node lets a TypeError from a nested hook propagate out of inspect; a catch-all prints the interrupted marker instead.

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_cycle_bounded dies when a Buffer hook re-swallows the overflow it already reported
mutations.why: without the identity rethrow each enclosing Buffer hook swallows the latched overflow again, so a Buffer with two ways back returns instead of throwing like node.
expect_detail: 2 refs inspect outcome: want threw got returned

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_cycle_bounded dies when util's hook-side overflow latch is removed
mutations.why: without the latch every enclosing hook re-descends to the stack limit per key, so `b.k0 = b; b.k1 = b` does work like 2^depth and never finishes.

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_cycle_bounded dies when console's hook-side overflow latch is removed
mutations.why: console.log of a Buffer with two ways back to itself would never finish.

mutations.name: 71-inspect-hook-ancestor-cycle dies when a hook's util.inspect stops catching the stack overflow
mutations.why: a user hook inspecting its own ancestor made util.inspect throw RangeError; node catches and prints.

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_hook_ancestor_cycle dies when console's hook inspect stops catching the stack overflow
mutations.why: console.log of a parent-pointer structure with a custom hook would throw RangeError and kill the process.

mutations.name: 70-buffer-size-inspect-parity dies when top-level util.inspect catches errors thrown by a hook's own getter
mutations.why: node catches overflow only while formatting, so a getter throwing a forged overflow RangeError propagates; catching at the top swallows it and changes cycle outcomes.
mutations.find: return hookNesting === 0 ? inspect(v, opts, [], 0) : hookInspect(v, opts);

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_cycle_bounded dies when util passes hooks a depth-inheriting closure instead of util.inspect
mutations.why: node passes util.inspect itself; the old closure also bypasses the overflow latch, so cycles stop terminating.
mutations.replace: return v[customInspect](depth, opts, function (val, o) { return inspect(val, o || opts, [v], depth + 1); });

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_cycle_bounded dies when console hands hooks the old one-argument closure
mutations.why: the closure dropped options (wrong depth for extras) and bypasses the overflow latch.
mutations.replace: return v[customInspect](depth, {}, function (val) { return inspect(val, [v], depth + 1); });

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_extras_cap dies when the Buffer extras string-key cap moves
mutations.why: the string-key scan is O(length), capped at 64 (cost recorded in buffer.js).

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_extras_pollution dies when the hook reads showHidden through the prototype chain
mutations.why: a polluted Object.prototype.showHidden would list hidden properties of every logged Buffer.

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_extras_pollution dies when the hook reads depth through the prototype chain
mutations.why: a polluted Object.prototype.depth = null would lift the depth bound on every logged Buffer's extras.

mutations.name: buffer_inspect_extras_pollution dies when console's hook inspect reads depth through the prototype chain
mutations.why: a polluted Object.prototype.depth = null would lift the depth bound for every custom hook's sub-inspect under console.log.
